warnings.headline: Yellow Thunderstorm Warning for Portalegre
warnings.description: Favorable conditions for the occurrence of localized weather phenomena, such as: thunderstorms; locally heavy precipitation, with accumulations of 10 to 20 mm in 1 hour; hail with a diameter inferior to 2 cm; wind gusts between 70 and 90 km/h.
warnings.sender: Instituto Português do Mar e da Atmosfera
